location: src/providers/plugins/sso/session/processors/conversations/syncProcessor.ts:102-111 (per-run cap MAX_CONVERSATION_PAYLOADS_PER_RUN=50, constants.ts:52): candidates past the 50th are left pending for 'the next run', and the run still reports plain success ('Synced 50/50 conversations') with deferred=false
trigger_condition: The cap is only verified by calling runSync twice on the same un-renamed queue file. Nothing covers the SessionEnd pipeline, where the queue file is renamed straight after the one sync call, so there is no next run.
guard_snippet: A SessionEnd-path test, in hook-routing-contract.test.ts or a SessionSyncer test, that seeds more than MAX_CONVERSATION_PAYLOADS_PER_RUN pending records in {sessionId}_conversation.jsonl, runs processEvent(SessionEnd) with upsertConversation mocked, and asserts either that every record was sent or that the leftovers are still reachable by a later sync. Today they sit only in completed_{sessionId}_conversation.jsonl, which nothing reads.
potential_consequence: A session that ends with more than 50 unsent candidates sends 50. handleSessionEnd then calls renameSessionFiles (hook.ts:239), which moves the queue to completed_{id}_conversation.jsonl. getSessionConversationPath (session-config.ts:66-68) and readJSONL (jsonl-reader.ts:19-23) have no completed_ fallback, so the proxy timer, the onProxyStop final sync (sso.session-sync.plugin.ts:211-229) and stale-session reconciliation (skips completed_, stale-session-reconciliation.ts:92) never send the rest. Before this change the cap did not exist; only the 2s deadline could defer work. The new dedupe test's second runSync passes because it re-reads the same file.
consumer: handleSessionEnd in src/cli/commands/hook.ts:217-240 (syncPendingDataToAPI then renameSessionFiles), reached by the Claude SessionEnd hook and by the opencode/codex onSessionEnd routes (opencode.plugin.ts:442-449)
evidence: Read syncProcessor-dedupe.test.ts 'per-run cap (AC6)': it asserts 50 calls, then runs runSync again on the same file and asserts conv-50 is sent. Read hook-routing-contract.test.ts:220-245: the SessionEnd test asserts only the rename and the session status, with no conversation records and no upsert assertions. A grep of src/ and tests/ for MAX_CONVERSATION_PAYLOADS_PER_RUN, handleSessionEnd and completed_.*_conversation in *.test.ts found nothing else, except tests/integration/agent-task-session.test.ts:234, which I did not open. Read getSessionConversationPath, readJSONL and stale-session-reconciliation to confirm no reader picks up completed_ conversation files.

location: src/agents/plugins/claude/session/processors/claude.conversations-processor.ts:198-217 (dedupe-before-append): an already-queued turn is skipped but the drain loop still moves localSync forward and keeps going
trigger_condition: Both new Claude dedupe tests use a single-turn transcript (u1/a1), so no test has an already-queued turn followed by a not-yet-queued turn in the same drain.
guard_snippet: In claude.conversations-processor-dedupe.test.ts, use a two-turn transcript (u1,a1,u2,a2). Seed the queue with only turn 1's payloadId, leave the session pointer unset, run processSession, and assert that readQueued() has 2 records, that the second record's payloadId is turn 2's uuid, and that its historyIndices are [1,1], meaning the skipped turn still advanced the history index.
potential_consequence: Several smallest regressions would pass both new tests: a break (instead of falling through) after the skip branch, or skipping without carrying result.currentHistoryIndex into localSync. Either would leave the turn after a lagging pointer unqueued, or queue it under a reused history_index. The collapse step (payloadQueue.ts collapseSupersededPayloads) keys on conversationId|history_index|role, so it would then mark the older turn superseded and never send it. Test 1 still passes because the skipped turn is the last one, and test 2 because there is only one turn to dedupe.
consumer: ConversationsProcessor.process drain loop driven by the Claude Stop/SubagentStop hooks via performIncrementalSync (hook.ts:224), whose output the sync processor at syncProcessor.ts:86-111 consumes
evidence: Read claude.conversations-processor-dedupe.test.ts in full. Its messages fixture has one user/assistant pair (lines 19-32), test 1 seeds that single turn as queued, and test 2 runs the same single turn twice. The skip branch at claude.conversations-processor.ts:198-201 only exists in this diff, so pre-existing Claude processor tests cannot reach it.
